links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT classification of ARV drug-drug interactions versus HIV-specific reference resources
links.effect: Correctly classified 40.4% (38/94) of pairs; errors mostly false negatives (34/56; 60.7%). Sensitivity 46.0%, specificity 29.0%, PPV 56.9%, NPV 20.9%.
links.quote: ChatGPT correctly classified just 40.4% (38/94) of DDI pairs; errors were primarily false negatives (34/56 errors; 60.7%).

links.outcome: Output accuracy against ground-truth reference standards (HIV/HCV Drug Therapy Guide, Liverpool checker)
links.effect: Only 40.4% of DDI pairs correctly classified; mean composite score 3.9/8; severity identification 0.4/2 for serious DDIs; management 0.9/2.
links.quote: ChatGPT showed limited accuracy in identifying severity of serious DDIs (0.4/2), despite often correctly identifying mechanism (1.4/2) and clinical effects (1.6/2).

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and clinical reliability of ChatGPT4o-mini in identifying antiretroviral drug-drug interactions against standard clinical reference databases without testing a deployment practice.
